_register: Informal du (never the obsolete formal De) in sentences addressed to the reader, as Norwegian Bokmål software does; buttons, menu entries and step lists use the imperative (Lån ut, Lagre, Skann strekkoden); no jokes, no exclamation marks; neutral wording such as « elev », « lærer », « låner », no gendered forms.
_quotes: Norwegian guillemets «text» with no space inside them (e.g. Utlånt: «{{title}}»); nested quotes use ‘ ’ or „ “; no space before : ; ? !; the arrow → stays; compounds are written as one word (utlånsliste, ikke « utlåns liste »); dates as 31.12.2026 and decimal comma.
_plural: Two plural forms, one and other (e.g. {{count:plural; one:elev; other:elever;}}); the definite singular is also marked on the noun (eksemplaret, eksemplarene), so keep the whole phrase inside each option when the article or the ending changes.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; plural « eksemplarer » (definite « eksemplarene »). Never « kopi ».

record.note: The catalogue entry of a title (Bibliofil and Mikromarc say « post » or « bibliografisk post »); « katalogpost » is used so that « post » alone is not ambiguous.

patron.note: Usual word in Norwegian library systems (Bibliofil, Mikromarc, Koha); plural « lånere », definite « låneren ». « Bruker » is not used, it also means the staff user.

card.note: Short form « kort » where the context is clear.

loan.note: The action and the loan itself; the verb is « låne ut », the imperative on buttons « Lån ut ».

return.note: The action, as in Norwegian library systems; the verb is « levere inn », « registrere innlevering ». « Retur » is not used.

renew.note: Extending the due date; « fornying » is the noun, « forlenge » is not used. Keep « fornye » everywhere.

due date.note: Usual in Norwegian library systems; « leveringsfrist » is also heard, but only one is used.

overdue.note: Adjective for a loan past the due date (« forfalt utlån », « forfalte utlån »). « På overtid » is not used.

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; plural « purringer ».

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS); « signatur » is the short form where the context is clear, « plassering » is not used.

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and hyllesignatur on the spine; « ryggetikett » is the plain spine label and is not used for the band.

barcode.note: Plural « strekkoder »; « barkode » is not used.

class.note: A school class such as 3 B; plural « klasser ».

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; « revisjon » is the short form in menus. « Varetelling » and « inventar » are not used.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « innkjøpsforslag » is the formal alternative and is not used.

census.note: Registering the låneren with their photo; the verb is « registrere med bilde ».

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year (3 B becomes 4 B); the verb is « rykke opp ».

anonymise.note: Erase the personal data of a patron for good.

staff account.note: A shared login per role; « ansattkonto » is not used.

backup.note: Plural « sikkerhetskopier »; the verb is « ta sikkerhetskopi ».

colour set.note: The palette of the interface; written « farge ».

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; « skanner » alone is the verb and the device in general, and « strekkodeleser » avoids confusion with a document scanner. The verb for reading a code is « skanne ».

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with; « demodata » is not used.

configuration.note: As in Norwegian software; « konfigurasjon » only for the configuration file and the archive.

note.note: A free note on a record or patron; « notat » is not used.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is « Utlån ».
